englishTranslation: Sticky rice dumpling with mung bean and pork
atAGlance: Xôi khúc is sticky rice dumpling with khúc leaves, usually with mung bean, pork filling, and herbal green rice.
whatItIs: Xôi khúc is sticky rice wrapped around a khúc-leaf dumpling with mung bean and pork inside. It is warm, dense, herbal, and especially loved as a northern breakfast.
howToEnjoy: Eat it warm and break into the center so the mung bean, pork, and herbal dough mix with the sticky rice. It is filling, so one portion can be plenty.
howLocalsOrder: Order xôi khúc early in the day if you see it at a stall. Ask whether it has pork if you are avoiding meat; the filling is often hidden until you bite in.
worthKnowing: In northern Vietnam, khúc leaf gives this sticky-rice dumpling its herbal character, making it feel different from ordinary xôi packets.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần xôi khúc.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of sticky rice dumpling with mung bean and pork.
